arg.name: pipelines
arg.description: Comma-separated planning pipelines to benchmark, in order.

arg.name: iterations
arg.description: Number of forward+reverse MOTR repetitions per pipeline.

arg.name: launch_rviz
arg.description: Launch RViz for each per-pipeline run (off by default for an unattended comparison).

arg.name: output_dir
arg.description: Directory for the parent comparison run folder.

arg.name: timestamp
arg.description: Parent folder suffix (benchmark_fanuc-driver_<timestamp>). 'auto' -> orchestrator uses the current date-time.

executable.cmd: python3 $(find-pkg-share fanuc_benchmark)/test/run_pipeline_comparison.py --pipelines $(var pipelines) --output-dir $(var output_dir) --timestamp $(var timestamp) --robot-model $(var robot_model) --robot-ip $(var robot_ip) --iterations $(var iterations) --velocity-scaling $(var velocity_scaling) --acceleration-scaling $(var acceleration_scaling) --planning-time $(var planning_time) --launch-rviz $(var launch_rviz)
